page_title: MCI 5-2 CRY | Manchester City v Crystal Palace 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Crystal Palace comes to nothing.
90+7' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
90+4' Yellow card. Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.

90+1' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jarred Gillett stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Manchester City have a free kick.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
89' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
89' The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Here comes a substitution. Mateo Kovacic is given a rest as he is replaced by Jack Grealish (Manchester City).
87' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Kevin De Bruyne is replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
87' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and James McAtee leaves the pitch and Savinho (Manchester City) comes on.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Omar Marmoush walks off the pitch to be replaced by Oscar Bobb (Manchester City).
82' Crystal Palace are ruled offside.
80' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Adam Wharton and he is replaced by Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace).
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) coming on for Eberechi Eze.

79' 5 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Dean Henderson. He makes it 5:2.
77' James McAtee (Manchester City) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. That's a free kick to Crystal Palace.
76' The linesman signals that Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
75' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul. Crystal Palace have a free kick.
71' Ederson (Manchester City) is being substituted because of an injury. Pep Guardiola sends Stefan Ortega on the pitch.
70' Ederson (Manchester City) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
68' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to James McAtee (Manchester City) for his blatant foul.
67' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
65' The game is interrupted now, Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
64' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
64' The free kick is taken by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), but ball is cleared.
63' Substitution. Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) in, Maxence Lacroix out.
63' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Tyrick Mitchell will be replaced by Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace).

60' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to keep the ball from hitting the net.

60' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Dean Henderson guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
58' Poor challenge! Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is penalised for tripping and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle.
56' 4 - 2 Ederson plays a terrific cross over to James McAtee (Manchester City), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
55' It seemed like Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
54' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
54' A clumsy foul by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle.
51' James McAtee (Manchester City) fails to keep his cool and squanders a golden chance to score from inside the penalty area after firing the ball over the crossbar.
47' 3 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Oliver Glasner gives a chance to Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) and Jean-Philippe Mateta is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
45+2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches over the bar. He should have scored!
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

43' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Free kick. Crystal Palace will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
40' Nico (Manchester City) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
36' 2 - 2 Goal! Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 2:2.
34' James McAtee (Manchester City) plants his close-range header just wide of the left post after a cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.

33' 1 - 2 Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the free kick from a promising position. He has already proven that he can handle such situations and once again, he sends the ball goalwards and it bounces in off the left post.
32' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
31' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

31' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jarred Gillett blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Manchester City are awarded the free kick.
29' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
26' Chance! Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Daichi Kamada, but his shot from inside the box flashes just over the bar.
24' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
21' 0 - 2 Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a bullet header from close range into the middle of the net. The score is 0:2.
21' It will be a corner kick for Crystal Palace.
18' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
18' Jarred Gillett blows the whistle, Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Manchester City get a free kick.
15' Crystal Palace concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. A free kick to Manchester City.
14' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

13' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.

13' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Dean Henderson anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Ismaila Sarr plays a simple square pass into the feet of Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
5' James McAtee (Manchester City) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Dean Henderson easily deals with the threat.
4' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
3' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
1' The first half has started.
Manchester City will kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
